metadata.title: Smoked Haddock Kedgeree Recipe
metadata.description:
This curry inspired rice dish was brought back to the UK from colonial India and is traditionally eaten for breakfast or brunch. If you're not quite up to curried fish in the morning then enjoy it as an awesome mid-week meal!

nodes.plm_action: Make yourked haddock stock by making a stock with the fish bones and adding some herbs (such as parsley, dill or thyme).
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows two men cooking, in what appears to be a restaurant. There is bright natural lighting, and many ingredients and cooking utensils can be seen in the background.
The two men cook together and speak as they cook and show the audience how to make a haddock, rice, and peas dish. The man on the left is wearing a black chef's coat, and has glasses. The man on the right is wearing a red and black plaid shirt, and does not have glasses.

The cooking process begins with them cutting up fruits and vegetables. Then, a pot on the stove is used to bring the ingredients to a boil. Other ingredients are added as they become ready, and the men use a variety of cooking utensils. The dish is presented in the final stages, on a white plate.

 bright and even lighting is provided by natural light. A variety of background detail is visible, including shelf, containers, fruit and hanging planters.

summary.brief: Two chefs make smoked haddock kedgeree, poaching the fish, cooking spiced rice, and finishing with peas, herbs, lemon and a poached egg.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a close‑up of the finished kedgeree and the chefs introducing the dish. The chef in the black coat poaches smoked haddock in milk until just cooked, then removes it. He sautés leeks and garlic in butter, adds curry powder, a splash of wine and stock, and cooks basmati rice until fluffy and aromatic. The poached fish is flaked into large chunks and folded into the rice together with bright green peas, fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice. A soft‑poached egg is placed on top, the mixture is gently stirred, and the dish is plated on a white plate, garnished with extra parsley and a lemon wedge. The chefs taste the finished kedgeree before the video ends with branding graphics.

action.detailed: Poach the smoked haddock in milk, sauté leeks and garlic in butter, add curry powder, wine and stock to the rice, cook the rice until tender, flake the fish and fold it into the rice with peas, parsley and lemon juice, top with a poached egg, stir gently and plate the dish.
action.actor: the chef wearing the black coat and glasses (the left‑handed chef)

nodes.plm_action: Create a beurre manié with the flour.
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features two men in a kitchen working together to prepare a dish of food. The two men work swiftly and are well coordinated. They start by cutting up vegetables, then begin to chop up fish and cook it in pots over the stove. Both men speak to the camera.
In the background, there are some white cabinets, and dark blue accent wall. There is also a black framed picture on the wall and metal shelves with fruit and plants on them. The video is set in the kitchen.

summary.brief: Two chefs make smoked haddock kedgeree, poaching the fish in milk, cooking spiced rice, and finishing with peas, herbs, lemon and soft‑boiled eggs.
summary.detailed: The video begins with the chefs rinsing and chopping leeks and garlic, then sweating them in butter (with a splash of wine) in a pan. They stir in curry powder, add a little flour, then add basmati rice and pour in stock, letting the mixture simmer until the rice is fluffy. In a separate saucepan they bring milk to a gentle boil and poach the smoked haddock; the skin slips off and the fish is flaked into large pieces. Soft‑boiled eggs are prepared in hot water, peeled and quartered. The chefs stir peas, chopped parsley, a squeeze of lemon juice, the flaked fish and the egg quarters into the cooked rice, mixing briefly so the fish stays in chunks. They plate the kedgeree, give a quick taste, and smile at the camera.

action.detailed: Poach the smoked haddock in milk, cook the basmati rice with leeks, garlic, butter, flour, curry powder and stock, then combine the flaked fish, peas, parsley, lemon juice and quartered soft‑boiled eggs, stir gently, and serve.
action.actor: the chef in a black coat with glasses and his partner in a red‑plaid shirt

nodes.plm_action: Serve the toad in the hole immediately.
nodes.plm_caption: Two men demonstrate how to make smoked salmon scotch eggs in a kitchen with pots and pans. The scene is shown in fast motion. The men prepare the eggs in pots on a cooktop in a small kitchen area. They show how to mix seasoning in and push the mixture on to a plate. It is shown how to finish the eggs with more seasoning, cut lemon, and serve. A table and chairs are shown. Two men are preparing and serving the dish on a white plate.

summary.brief: The chefs stir peas, parsley, lemon juice and chopped boiled egg into the rice dish, then plate it with poached eggs and garnish before tasting and showing the final logo.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of the pot containing the rice mixture; the chef in the red‑plaid shirt drops green peas, a sprig of parsley, a squeeze of lemon juice and chopped hard‑boiled egg into the pot while the chef in the black shirt sprinkles a pinch of white powder and stirs everything with a wooden spoon. After a brief final stir, they spoon the hot mixture onto a white plate, place two poached eggs on top, add extra parsley and a lemon wedge for garnish, present the finished dish to the camera and taste it, and the video ends with a red “S” logo and branding screen.

action.detailed: Add peas, parsley, lemon juice and chopped boiled egg to the pot, sprinkle a pinch of white powder, stir, then spoon the mixture onto a plate, top with poached eggs, garnish and present the dish.
action.actor: the two chefs – one wearing a black shirt and the other in a red and black plaid shirt

nodes.plm_action: Boil the fish, then strain and flake it.
nodes.plm_caption: The video is of two men demonstrating how to cook a dish on a kitchen counter. You see the two men with different cooking styles, and with different clothes while demonstrating how to cook a dish. The left one is demonstrating while he listens to the cooking instructions, while the other one, wearing a black chef's uniform, is actually cooking the dish while he listens to the person giving the instructions. There is some sound of people talking in the background. The two men are in a kitchen on a wooden counter top, and there are many utensils on the counter top. One of them is wearing a black shirt, the other is wearing a red plaid shirt. There are wooden cutting boards and knives on the counter top. There is a sink in the background. They are demonstrating how to cook a "smoked haddock kedgeree", there is a plate of cooked haddock on the table and an egg on top. The cooking process is shown in detail, and there are many ingredients, chopped vegetables, and dishes being cooked on the counter top. There are two different men demonstrating, one is talking in front of the camera, while he is listening to the cooking instructions from the other man. The two men are demonstrating how to cook the dish step-by-step.

summary.brief: The chef poaches smoked haddock in milk while sautéing leeks and garlic, then cooks spiced basmati rice to finish the kedgeree.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with the chef rinsing a leek, melting butter in a pan, and sweating the leek together with crushed garlic. He seasons the vegetables with curry powder and a splash of white wine, then reduces the mixture. In a separate saucepan he brings milk to a gentle boil and slides the smoked haddock in to poach, allowing the fish to flavor the milk. After the milk is removed from the heat, the poached fish is set aside. The chef returns to the leeks, adds basmati rice and dissolved stock cubes, and stirs everything together, letting the rice absorb the liquid and cook gently until the grains are plump and coated with the aromatic sauce. The dish is now ready for the final garnish.

action.brief: Poach haddock and simmer spiced rice
action.detailed: Heat milk in a saucepan, add the smoked haddock to poach it, meanwhile melt butter and sweat leeks and garlic, season with curry powder and wine, reduce, then stir basmati rice and stock into the leeks, and simmer until the rice is plump and flavored.
action.actor: the man wearing the black chef’s coat

nodes.plm_action: Add butter, salt, and pepper, then cook until browned on top, stirring constantly.
nodes.plm_caption: This video features two men standing and working side by side in a kitchen, with wooden countertops and stainless steel shelving. They both have medium length dark hair, glasses and are wearing work shirts with their hands at their sides, while they prepare fish and rice. In the left corner are sink, cabinets and bottles. In the back right corner is a picture and on the shelves are various containers and a red teapot. There is a painting that says "Fill me up". The camera is handheld.

summary.brief: The two chefs stir a rice mixture, poach and flake smoked fish, add an egg, peas, herbs and lemon, then plate the kedgeree.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with the chef in the black coat stirring a pot of rice, onions and leeks while the assistant in the red‑plaid shirt pours a yellow broth into the pot. The mixture continues to be stirred as the black‑clad chef reaches for a jug of white wine, poaches the smoked haddock in it, removes the fish, skins it and flakes it into large chunks. He then cracks a raw egg into the pot and folds it into the rice mixture. Afterward the chefs add sweet peas, freshly chopped parsley and lemon wedges, give the dish a final stir, and transfer the finished kedgeree to serving bowls.

action.detailed: Stir the rice and vegetable mixture, pour in the broth, poach the haddock in wine, flake the fish, crack an egg into the pot, fold in peas, chopped herbs and lemon, then combine everything and plate the dish.
action.actor: the chef wearing the black coat

nodes.plm_action: Adding a touch of coriander and lemon juice
nodes.plm_caption:
A close up shot of two men cooking on the stove. The left guy is wearing a black top while the guy on the right is wearing a red and black plaid shirt. The person on the right adds some green peas, a sprig of green parsley, and lemon juice into the pot and stirs it around. He also adds some chopped up hard boiled egg to the pot, which he stirs the ingredients in. The scene has a professional feel to it due to how close up it is and how everything is in focus.
At the 0:03 second mark, the guy on the left adds a small amount of a white powder onto the ingredients in the pot. This adds a final touch.
At the 0:06 second mark, the clip stops and starts again at the 0:09 second mark with a new camera clip. During this, a small wooden spoon is lifted, which can be seen for the rest of the video up to the ending. The clip stops again at the 0:14 second mark, which shows the pot full of ingredients cooking for the final time. The clip ends.
At 0:14 the clip starts with a close up of the white powder being sprinkled in a pot. It stops at 0:22 which shows the white powder being mixed. At 0:22 it stops again to 0:30, during which it is mixed. It then ends with the clip being cut off.
The lighting is bright with a professional, studio feel to it. The camera is focused on the people and the food, and there's not much going on in the background.

summary.brief: The cooks fold peas, parsley, lemon juice, chopped egg and a pinch of white powder into the pot and give it a final stir.
summary.detailed: In a close‑up of the stovetop, the man in the red‑and‑black plaid shirt drops green peas, a sprig of fresh parsley, a splash of lemon juice and chopped hard‑boiled egg into the pot of rice and fish, stirring as he goes. The man in the black top then sprinkles a small amount of white powder over the mixture. A wooden spoon is lifted and used to stir everything together until the ingredients are evenly incorporated.

action.detailed: Add peas, parsley, lemon juice, and chopped hard‑boiled egg to the pot, sprinkle a pinch of white powder, and stir the mixture with a wooden spoon until fully combined.
action.actor: the two men cooking, one in a black top and the other in a red‑and‑black plaid shirt

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a cooking demonstration of a dish made with rice, and possibly other vegetables. Two men are cooking this dish. At the end the man in the black shirt holds the plate with the food and presents it to the camera. There is a letter S in white font in the middle of a red background.

summary.brief: The chefs plate the finished kedgeree, garnish it, taste the dish, and the video ends with a stylized “S” logo.
summary.detailed: The chef in the black shirt scoops the cooked rice‑and‑fish mixture from the pot onto a white rectangular plate, places a poached egg on top, sprinkles fresh herbs and adds a lemon wedge, and holds the plated dish toward the camera while his partner in the red‑plaid shirt watches. Both chefs then taste the dish, using forks to lift bites of rice, fish and egg and bringing them to their mouths; close‑up shots show the forks flipping bits of food and cleaning the plate. The segment intercuts a graphic of a white “S” on a red background, then returns to an overhead view of the completed plate—a bed of rice with vegetables, two soft‑boiled eggs and a lemon wedge—before fading to black.

action.detailed: Plate the cooked kedgeree onto a white plate, top it with a poached egg, sprinkle herbs and a lemon wedge, present the plate to the camera, then eat it with a fork.
action.actor: the chef wearing the black shirt

nodes.plm_action: Add the sugar, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
nodes.plm_caption: The video features an introduction to a smoked haddock kedgeree. It begins with a closeup shot of the dish and then immediately cuts to a live shot of two individuals cooking on a countertop next to a sink and a cooker. Both men are standing on the same side of the countertop and they are facing the camera, as the man on the left, who is speaking while gesturing with his hands, is also holding the camera at this point. The man on the right is focused on cooking. Several closeup shots of specific ingredients and the cooking process are interspersed with the individuals and the cooking area. We see them preparing the ingredients, chopping and mashing them, and mixing them together in a pot. Then we see them adding cream and mango puree before briefly cutting back to a shot of the dish. The video ends with the man in the black shirt holding the finished dish in his hands above the pot before the camera pans out, and his face briefly comes into view.  The video is quite fast-paced.

summary.brief: Two cooks prepare smoked haddock kedgeree by chopping vegetables and simmering them with butter, milk and seasonings.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a quick graphic splash and a close‑up of the finished kedgeree, then cuts to a kitchen where two men stand side‑by‑side at the countertop. The man in the red plaid shirt gathers the raw ingredients while the man in the black shirt begins chopping leeks, celery, onion and garlic on a wooden board. The chopped leeks are rinsed in a plastic colander, then all the vegetables are transferred to a large pan. Butter, flour, salt, pepper and a splash of oil are added, followed by milk and a peeled orange squash; the mixture is stirred, then peas and a light brown stock are poured in and the pot is left to simmer gently, allowing the flavors to meld. The camera speeds through the preparation and ends with the chef lifting the finished kedgeree toward the camera while both men smile.

action.detailed: Add butter, flour, milk, peeled orange squash, peas, stock and the rinsed chopped vegetables to a pan, stir and simmer until the kedgeree is cooked.
action.actor: the man wearing the black shirt (the chef)

nodes.plm_caption: A person is holding a pan with liquid in it on top of a stove. The camera zooms out slightly, showing the entire stove top. Then the person removes their hands off the top and only the pan is visible. It zooms out further to show that the pan is on a wooden counter. The person then puts their hand back on the pan. There is a stove light on the left of the pot. The pot is silver, and the stove is black, with a tan wood counter.

summary.brief: A milk‑filled saucepan simmers on the burner while the cook briefly lifts and returns it, with the camera pulling back to show the countertop.
summary.detailed: The scene opens on a stainless‑steel saucepan containing a white, milky liquid that is bubbling on a black induction burner; a hand holds the pan as the camera zooms out to reveal the entire stove top. The cook then removes the hand, leaving the pan alone on the burner, and the view widens further to show the pan sitting on a tan wooden counter. Finally, the cook places a hand back on the saucepan, indicating that the heating will continue.

action.detailed: Place the saucepan with milk on the induction burner, bring the liquid to a gentle boil, briefly lift the pan, and then set it back on the burner to continue heating.
action.actor: the cook

nodes.plm_action: Add the rice and chicken stock to the pot and stir.
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a cooking tutorial. There are two men involved in the cooking. The one wearing a black t-shirt has short, dark hair, and black glasses. The other one wears a red and black checkered shirt. The man in red stirs the ingredients for rice and chicken broth while the other adds the chicken broth. They are in a kitchen with white cabinets and various jars behind them.

summary.brief: The chefs add milk and broth to a simmering pot of rice while stirring.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with the man in the red plaid shirt holding a bowl and pouring a white liquid—likely milk or cream—into a silver pot that already contains rice and vegetables. He then adds measured rice to the pot as the chef in the black shirt watches. Both chefs stir the mixture continuously with a wooden spoon. Next, the chef in the black shirt lifts a glass measuring cup filled with a yellow liquid, presumably stock or broth, and pours it into the same pot while keeping the spoon in motion. The camera shifts to a close‑up of the pot, now showing onions, leeks, rice and the two liquids swirling together, with the wooden spoon still inserted as the final splash is added.

action.detailed: Pour the white milk‑like liquid and then the yellow broth from the measuring cups into the simmering pot while stirring continuously with a wooden spoon.
action.actor: the two chefs, one wearing a black shirt and glasses and the other wearing a red plaid shirt

nodes.plm_action: Mix in the fish with the sauce and finish cooking in the saucepan, skin side down, for 2 minutes.
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows two men in a kitchen preparing a meal. The man on the left is dressed in a black chef's coat, while the man on the right is in a red plaid shirt. He is holding a glass measuring cup.
The video has text, numbers and action shots. Text reads 15 MINS as well as "use ready" and "add flour," "add potato, egg, milk." There are multiple images of the men making their food.
They start by mashing the onions and stirring them constantly, before adding more ingredients from a pot of boiling water. Then, the man on the left makes fish at a cutting board and then begins to cook an egg on the stove and continues to chop vegetables.
Towards the end, the two men are holding a saucepan and talking to each other, before pouring the contents of the pan out. The video ends with two men holding bowls of chopped vegetables and a lemon.
The video is in fast forward speed, so the man on the right wears the shirt with only the left side shown and the man on the left holds the measuring cup only.
The walls of the kitchen are painted white and have a painting of a wine glass hanging on the right. There are various items on the shelves as well as a red refrigerator on the right. There is a sink in the kitchen behind the man on the left. A black stove top and wooden chopping board are on the counter.

summary.brief: The chefs finish the kedgeree by stirring the rice‑curry base, adding poached fish, a cracked egg, peas, and a lemon‑herb garnish.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with the chef in the black coat stirring a simmering pot while his partner in the red plaid shirt holds a measuring cup of liquid and pours it into the mixture. The poached haddock is lifted from the liquid, its skin discarded, and the fillets are split and flaked on a cutting board. An egg is cracked onto the board and the yolk is poured into the pot, where it is folded into the rice‑curry base. Throughout the next moments the two chefs exchange lids and spoons, keep the mixture moving, and the chef in black chops the flaked fish further. The red‑shirted chef chops a lemon and fresh green herbs. A handful of green peas is added, followed by the chopped lemon and herbs, which are transferred from a small bowl into the pot. The final shots show the ingredients being gently mixed together, completing the kedgeree.

action.detailed: Stir the rice‑curry pot, fold in the flaked poached fish, pour in the cracked egg, add peas, lemon and chopped herbs, then gently mix until everything is evenly combined.
action.actor: the chef wearing the black chef's coat

nodes.plm_action: Add cooked peas to the mixture and toss together.
nodes.plm_caption: The video features two men putting ingredients into a pan. They add peas, parsley, lemon, and chopped white onions.  They are demonstrating a recipe.

summary.brief: The cooks finish the kedgeree by adding peas, parsley and lemon juice, then stirring the pot.

nodes.plm_caption:
Two men preparing a recipe and demonstrating to the camera. The video is sped up a lot.
The man on the left of the frame is in a red and black plaid shirt. He has his hands in a relaxed position at the beginning and front of his body, as the camera zooms in on him. At 0:10, the scene shifts to an arrangement of ingredients on a wooden table. The ingredients on the right are a lemon, a mango, 4 eggs, 2 garlic cloves, and a small bowl of a brown powder. The man on the left moves to his right and prepares the ingredients for cooking while he speaks with the other man. On the right of the frame, there's a plate full of ingredients that will be used. 
The man on the right is in a black shirt. The plate that was on the right shows the man in the red shirt is holding. At the beginning of the scene, the man in the black shirt extends his left hand to show the camera the ingredients on the plate and then proceeds to chop and prepare the vegetables for cooking.
The man on the left uses a wooden spoon to put the chopped ingredients into a pot on the stove. He mixes the ingredients in the pot.
The man in the red shirt uses a clear plastic strainer to hold and scoop the mango slices. At the same time, he also picks up one of the mango slices from a plate on the left, then proceeds to chop it into two halves. The man in the red shirt picks one of the slices and puts it into the pot with the man in the black shirt. Then, he does the same with another one. This step is shown twice with both mango slices.
The man in the black shirt takes a piece of mango and puts it in the pot twice as the camera speeds up the video. He picks up another piece to repeat the process.
At the end of the video, the man in the red shirt wipes his left hand with a brown paper towel and folds his sleeves up.  He proceeds to pick up a piece of paper towel and uses it to wipe his hands. The man in the black shirt and the man in the red shirt are still engaged with the camera while the camera zooms out.

summary.brief: Two cooks chop leeks and garlic, rinse them, then build a creamy sauce with butter, flour, milk and seasonings, adding orange squash and peas.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the two men at a wooden countertop. The chef in the black shirt chops leeks (and a clove of garlic) on a cutting board, places the chopped pieces into a plastic colander and rinses them with water before dumping them into a bowl. He then heats a large two‑handle pan, adds butter and flour to make a roux, seasons with salt, pepper and a splash of oil, and stirs in the minced garlic. Milk is poured in, creating a creamy sauce that simmers. While the sauce cooks, the assistant in the red plaid shirt peels a bright orange squash, cuts it into pieces and adds the squash (and a bowl of green peas) to the pan, stirring them into the sauce. The mixture finishes cooking, and the men briefly wipe their hands before the camera pulls back.

action.detailed: The man in the black shirt chops leeks and garlic, rinses them in a colander, then adds butter, flour, salt, pepper, oil and garlic to a heated pan, pours milk to form a sauce, incorporates orange squash and peas, and stirs until the sauce is finished.
action.actor: the man wearing the black chef’s coat (black shirt)

nodes.plm_caption:
The video features a pair of chefs making poached cod in white wine. They stand next to a wooden worktop in a kitchen and are dressed in red and black clothing.
The cooking time is 10 minutes, as displayed in the right of frame red visual logo.

At 1s, the chef in red stands with his arms wide, while the chef in black is on the left. As the shot cuts to 3s, the chef in black reaches over to pick up a measuring jug of white wine. He turns his body back to the cooker where the cod is cooking. The chef in red picks up the measuring jug of white wine.
The chef in black gestures with his hands while the chef in red stands patiently by and gestures with his hand.
At 6s, the chef in black removes the cod from the water with a wooden spoon and drops it into a black bowl. This occurs as the chef in red leans over a second pot to the left of the first. This appears to be empty. The chef in black picks up a fork from a pot to the right and moves the cod with the fork and a knife to a cutting board in front of him. He separates the fish into two pieces and removes them from the skin.

They bring the pot with the cod towards them, placing it onto the wooden chopping board.

The chef in red retrieves a black bowl from on the right side and drops it on top of the chopping board.

The chef in black picks up a fork from the pot in front of him and stirs the mixture in the empty pot. He then picks up an egg, the egg is then positioned over the pot and begins to pour it into the pot.
He stirs the egg with the fork along with the other mixture before the clip cuts to a black square of a 2D colour illustration of a pot cooking, holding a poached cod and oil in the background.

summary.brief: The chefs pour wine into the simmering pot, lift the poached cod, strip its skin and flake it into a bowl, then stir a raw egg into the remaining liquid.
summary.detailed: The chef in the black coat lifts a measuring jug of white wine and pours it into the pot where the cod has been poaching. He then uses a wooden spoon to remove the cod, places it on a cutting board, removes the skin with a fork and knife and breaks the flesh into a bowl that the chef in the red plaid shirt sets on the board. After the fish is taken out, he returns to the empty pot, cracks a raw egg into it and quickly stirs the egg into the residual sauce, completing the final step of the kedgeree preparation.

action.detailed: Lift the poached cod from the pot with a wooden spoon, place it on a cutting board, strip off the skin and flake the flesh into a bowl, then crack a raw egg into the empty pan and stir it into the remaining liquid.
action.actor: the chef wearing a black chef’s coat

summary_sent_to_llm.description:
This curry inspired rice dish was brought back to the UK from colonial India and is traditionally eaten for breakfast or brunch. If you're not quite up to curried fish in the morning then enjoy it as an awesome mid-week meal!

Have you downloaded our BRAND NEW app yet? http://bit.ly/SortedYT

Get tonnes of behind the scenes stuff and extra foodie loveliness here:

Get the full recipe and ingredients at: http://sortedfood.com/kedgeree
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with a close‑up of the finished kedgeree and the chefs introducing the dish. The chef in the black coat poaches smoked haddock in milk until just cooked, then removes it. He sautés leeks and garlic in butter, adds curry powder, a splash of wine and stock, and cooks basmati rice until fluffy and aromatic. The poached fish is flaked into large chunks and folded into the rice together with bright green peas, fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice. A soft‑poached egg is placed on top, the mixture is gently stirred, and the dish is plated on a white plate, garnished with extra parsley and a lemon wedge. The chefs taste the finished kedgeree before the video ends with branding graphics.

You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to either of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   A video can match neither, one, or both. Be strict — when in doubt,
   say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
